claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bremen, Bremen, Neynaber, Bremen 4th and Southamp-
ton 8th August, with mdse. and pass. to Oelrichs & Co. Passed the
Needles at 9:45 a. m. Experienced westerly winds the entire passage
The steamship Hermann arrived at Hurst Castle Aug. 8, 2 a. m. Same
day at 5 a. m. passed steamship Allemania 80 miles west of the
Needles.

claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bremen (Brem), Neynaber, Bremen 4th and
Southampton 8th inst, with mdse and passengers, to Oelrichs
& Co. Experienced westerly winds the entire passage. Aug
16, 5:30 PM, lat 44 13, lon 48 55, passed steamship Helvetia,
hence for Liverpool; 20th, 1:20[?] AM, lat 41 09, lon 65 56, passed
a French steamship bound E; same day, 2:30 AM, lat 41 07,
lon 66 09, passed an Inman steamer, bound E.
